notes.title: Hamster Hunter 4.0! - Gambling Update | Modding Availability
notes.content:
[h1]Hamster Hunter 4.0 IS HERE![/h1]

[h2]Main Changes[/h2]

Gambling & Modding.
The game is now longer compiled in il2cpp and now just standard mono, this will allow players to have access to the code to create their own mods. The coding is quite sh*t. Although if you want to mod you now can.

Gambling is now in the game as well!

There also have been some UI changes and updates and some small bug fixes here and there.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed some issue causing multiplayer to not have a bat or rifle during the time needed.
Optimization in some areas.

Fixed other issues.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES V3.5 - Playable!
notes.content:
This Patch Fixes the largest bug players were having.
This bug was preventing players from interacting with Hamsters, Shops and other objects.

This patch fixes that and a few other small bugs as well.

notes.title: SEX UPDATE
notes.content:
In this very tame update you can now uhm.. have sex with Hamsters..

This is the most requested update to the game BY FAR!

In this update you are able to bring a Hamster to the bed and interact with it.
This will the player a chance to duplicate the Hamster and create an offspring, or there is a chance that it does not duplicate and just kills the Hamster.

This is now the only thing, there are a few optimization and little improvements here and there.
Next update will bring out some polishing and allow for the games longevity.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hamster Hunter Patch Notes[/h1]

In this patch we tried fixing a bunch of different errors that were brought with multiplayer.
We are still monitoring the situation and trying to figure out other bugs and issues.

There are a few small issues we are aware of that will be patched so although we wanted to get a more stable build out.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Fixed error causing currency amount to not show properly.
Fixed building previews showing when at the edge of the map.
Fixed the voicelines playing in multiplayer.
In night mode, your gun is still out for other players.
Open inventory tooltip may still show up after opening inventory.
Error causing singleplayer to not work after placing money generator.
The spawning on both when you first load in from the apartments, and when you load in after the tunnels.
The sensitivity slider.
Your torch not showing up at night time.
Your inventory not showing in singleplayer unless you restart (after quest progress 11)
Save files not loading properly.
Spawning in singleplayer was inconsistent.


There are quite a few other small patches and changes as well.

[h3]Notice[/h3]
With this patch there might be an issue with save files.
This seems to only occur if you played since the muliplayer update to now.

If you are experiencing this please join the discord @ discord.gg/Hamuno to convert the file over.

notes.title: Update Changes
notes.content:
[h1]Update Changes[/h1]

[h2]ADDITIONS:[/h2]
You can now save multiplayer progress.

Player Movement Character is now different to prevent movement issues with low FPS

Changed Settings menus to be more pleasing.

[h2]PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
Fixed multiplayer error causing inconsistencies in displaying actual currency amount.
Fixed building previews showing when at the edge of the map.
Fixed an error causing voice lines to be played in multiplayer.
Fixed an error causing your gun to be out during night.
Fixed a few popup and UI errors.
Fixed an issue with breeding pen rendering.
Fixed Emote preventing the gun the display sometimes.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update V3.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785733/3f9a1a7fcf032b43a1d8de788effdaaf719c9397.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]

- MULTIPLAYER OF COURSE!
- Emoting
- Character Customization
- Localization

[h3][b]Adjustments and Fixes:[/b][/h3]

- Nerfed Hamster Lure, now has a cap on lured Hamsters.
- TrapCages now guarantee a Hamster every 5 minutes if one does not enter it.
- A lot of small optimizations have been made as well.



Doesn't seem like much although trust me, multiplayer has been the biggest up date yet!
Stay tuned for the next update... you'll love it!

notes.title: Automation and Quality Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Automation Update V2.0
[/h1]

[h1]New Machines[/h1]

Added Hunter Drones
Added Plunger Turret
Added Breeding Pen
Added Slave Sled
Added Money Generators

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

Added a secret Golden Tranquilizer, found on the map somewhere ;)
Added Jumping in “Family Home Scene”
Added ability to hang Hamsters from the balcony

[h1]Adjustments and Fixes:[/h1]

Hamsters now will move toward the lure and not just around it
Fixed Hamster Cages not working
Fixed issue where blueprints wouldn’t collect right away unless you were at a weird angle
Added option to turn grass on or off in the settings
Slightly decrease grass render distance
Adjusted some mechanics to now only be accessible during the day (Example: Grinders)
Fixed issues of spawning guns and bats and hamsters in the players hand at once
Fixed Grinder sound not scaling with volume setting
Make some adjustments for the game to scale properly on different resolutions (not all)
Information now scales with cost of machine (there is still a random factor though)
Bullet Turrets now only work at night
Reworked how Hamsters Destroyed machines to allow more optimization and accurate destruction
Fixed Hamsters sometimes not spawning after night
Optimized a few performance issues
Small text adjustments
Small adjustments to turrets

notes.title: Optimization Hotfix
notes.content:
Optimized a lot of areas in general, especially night time.
Night time could cause lag that would make the game unplayable even on high end machines.

If you still encounter any issues let me know on Discord @ Discord.GG/Hamuno

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.3 (Simple HotFix)
notes.content:
Lowered Hamster Grinder Speed to prepare for automation update that is upcoming.

Added a tooltip for opening inventory.

Removed Hamster Enslavers, will be replacing with an updated version with automation update.

Fixed a few simple things bugs and errors.

notes.title: Hamster Hunter Update V1.2
notes.content:
Added 2 new Achievements

*Increased sprint speed to 8 instead of 7.5
*Increased walk speed to 3.5 instead of 3

*Increased sprint length from 10 seconds to 14
*Turret fire rate moved from 3 seconds → 2 seconds
*Turrets targeting tranquilized hamsters should be fixed

*Added light to emit from the firepit contraption

*Fixed Trap Cages asking for you to place a hamster

*Fixed bat not appearing when grinding at night

*Fixed gun re-appearing at night when placing a contraption

*Fixed hamsters not respawning after night time
*Fixed light not emitting from firepit contraption

*Reduced sway of all held items

*Reduced night time from 4 minutes to 3

notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.content:
* Nighttime now works differently, players will now be equipped with a baseball bat.
This is easier to kill the Hamsters.

* Hamsters now do more damage to your contraptions at night.
* Contraptions despawning after reloading save sometimes is now fixed.
* Fixed Turrets not adding kills to players total kill count
* Adjusted some wording with different text elements to state it's purpose more clearly
* Increase operation speed of the Hamster Grinder by 20%
* Fixed a few UI bugs
* Added a delete save button at the main menu under the settings.
